description: Does a forum post asserting a plausible wrong answer move the model away from the evidence-supported answer, compared with an unrelated post of similar character length? Each question has its own treatment and control.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.evidence: Government fact sheet: Canberra was purpose-built as the national capital and has housed Parliament House since 1927, although Sydney is the largest city.

condition_fragments.TREATMENT_COMPETING_CLAIM: Forum post: Many people say Sydney is the capital city of Australia.
condition_fragments.CONTROL_NEUTRAL: Forum post: Many people say the pool reopens late on Fridays in winter.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean by surface area?
questions.evidence: Atlas entry: The Pacific Ocean covers about 165 million square km, roughly one third of the planet, while the Atlantic covers about 106 million square km.

condition_fragments.TREATMENT_COMPETING_CLAIM: Forum post: Many people say the Atlantic is the largest ocean by surface area.
condition_fragments.CONTROL_NEUTRAL: Forum post: Many people say the museum opens late on Fridays in summer.

questions.question: Which chemical symbol stands for sodium?
questions.evidence: Chemistry handbook: Sodium has the symbol Na (from the Latin natrium) and atomic number 11; potassium, atomic number 19, uses the symbol K.

condition_fragments.TREATMENT_COMPETING_CLAIM: Forum post: Many people say K is the chemical symbol for sodium atoms.
condition_fragments.CONTROL_NEUTRAL: Forum post: Many people say the bakery opens early on Sundays in autumn.
